origin.details: The nid coefficient table at each tau, in the order print.summary.rqs walks the list.
origin.value: summary(fit, se='nid') tables at three taus
origin.example:
fit <- rq(y ~ x1 + x2, data=df, tau=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
s <- summary(fit, se="nid")
unlist(lapply(s, function(z) as.numeric(z$coef)))
